transcript.answer: The `skill-help` PR check runs `scripts/check-skill-help.sh`. For it to pass, the skill's SKILL.md must end with a `## Help` section. The body of that section must be fenced by `<!-- lore-help:begin -->` and `<!-- lore-help:end -->` markers, each alone on its own line. The check matches the markers anchored to the start of a line, so a mid-sentence mention doesn't count. The block must contain a `**Summary.**` line and a `**Usage:**` line. `**Use when.**`, `**Not for.**`, `**Examples**` and `**Related:**` are optional. I couldn't read the script itself, so I don't know every check it makes beyond presence and this shape.
